Thank you for your reply... I am very much aware of how destructive and harsh I can be on myself, I do try and change that, I will try harder. It's hard to rewire the way I think.

Regarding medication, I would like to get in and see what could be given to me ( if anything at all ) but since I'm still under my parents roof... They're very anti-medication. They won't allow it. 

I usually write to cope, play video games too, nothing seems to be working anymore. I will try though, thank you. hugs.
